title: Mo Bi Wu Si Huan
synopsis:
When the young woman realized that she had been confined to an enclosed time corridor of endless cycling with no way out, she struggled with all her might to fight and try to shatter the chains and bondage of doomed fate. She kept running, and running, trying to escape the arranged destiny and to find a way out of the enclosed "Mobius strip", and to pursue a different future for herself.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
